summary: Invech Holdings filed an 8-K/A amending a prior 8-K to update Items 1.01 and 2.01. The amendment reduces the purchase price of an asset acquired on March 3, 2026 from Andrew Chase Cochran from the original amount to $225,000, with the price paid via a convertible promissory note reduced proportionately, now convertible into 5,000,000 IVHI common shares. This is a post-closing settlement adjusting the terms of an already-completed acquisition. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory timeline is provided. The filing is a routine amendment correcting deal terms, not a new special-situation event. What to watch: impact on capitalization and dilution.
